description: A session is not reopened on another generation.

input.scenario: Session s1 was created on gen-0060; gen-0061 is now active; the host sends session/load for s1 with generation.id gen-0061.

expect.behaviour: The agent answers a JSON-RPC error whose data.hcsError.code is generation_mismatch; the host starts a new session on gen-0061 and session-limited grants of s1 do not apply to it.
